summary: THQ's sixth-generation MX trilogy, bridging the Ricky Carmichael motocross games and Rainbow Studios' later MX vs. ATV crossover.

emulation.notes: Use xemu or original Xbox hardware for the primary route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox fidelity with emulator upscaling

primary.why: MX 2002 released on PlayStation 2, Xbox, and Game Boy Advance. Public reception summaries note more positive comments about the Xbox version's controls and built-in tutorials, making it the best full-console route, while Game Boy Advance is a reduced handheld adaptation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox version on original hardware or xemu; use PS2 as the alternate console route and GBA only for portable preservation.

entries.title: MX Superfly featuring Ricky Carmichael
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox release with preserved downloadable content where available

emulation.notes: Use xemu or original Xbox hardware for the primary route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox fidelity with emulator upscaling

primary.version: Original Xbox release with preserved DLC where available
primary.why: MX Superfly released on Xbox, PlayStation 2, and GameCube. The Xbox version exclusively supported downloadable soundtrack, rider, and bike content through Xbox Live, so it is the most complete sourced route if that content is preserved.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox version on original hardware or xemu, with any preserved downloadable content if available; use PS2 or GameCube only as alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Xbox Live downloadable content may be difficult to preserve; without it, PS2/GameCube remain access alternatives but not better versions.

entries.title: MX Unleashed
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox release via original hardware or backward-compatible Xbox route

emulation.notes: Use xemu, original Xbox hardware, or documented Xbox backward compatibility for the primary route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox fidelity with emulator or backward-compatible output improvements

primary.version: Original Xbox release / Xbox backward-compatible route
primary.why: MX Unleashed released on PlayStation 2, Xbox, and mobile phones. The Xbox release is the best high-fidelity console route and is documented as backward compatible on Xbox One, while the mobile version is a reduced adaptation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox version on original hardware, xemu, or Xbox backward compatibility where available; use PS2 as the alternate console route and mobile only for preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; backward compatibility improves access but does not make a separate remaster.
